invariants.rationale: The rollback instant time should be defined for a rollback operation to target the correct instant.
A rollback is intended to target a specific commit instant, so the instant should be provided.
If skipLocking is true, it is likely safe only when not also deleting instants, suggesting a possible protocol invariant.
Rollback instant times are typically non-empty strings identifying the instant.
Deleting instants without locks may be disallowed for safety, so perhaps both are not true at the same time.
